# EasyMDE 2.18.0 (vendored)

Markdown editor for the admin post form, wired to the app's `POST /md/`
preview endpoint.

- Source: https://github.com/ionaru/easy-markdown-editor
- Version: 2.18.0 (the version the previous admin served from a CDN)
- License: MIT (see the header comment in `easymde.min.js`)
- Downloaded from: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/easymde@2.18.0/dist/
